name: Hamster Daisuki Uchuujin Uchuu-san ☆
original_name: ハムスター大好き宇宙人うチューさん☆
source:
A short visual novel in which you converse with "Uchu-san," an alien who loves hamsters.
You find yourself on an unfamiliar planet.
A blue hamster smiling kindly at you.
Is he an ally?
Or something else...?

[Translated from [url=https://siokanya.xrea.jp/utyu-.html]official website[/url]]
